history.reason: `resplit` is only for a leak, and split already re-cut itself once (9 facts to 8). A grep of ticket.md finds no sidecar/turn_ledger.json/END_OF_CONVERSATION/Desync, so r1's four facts rest on genuinely invented names (`read_sidecar`, `sidecar_state`, `verify_sidecar`, `TurnLedgerDesyncError`). The anchorless r2 facts are the stated exemption — a chosen value — and fact_sources.json gives each a real blind alternative (TERMINATE/[END]/DONE as token; substring, case-insensitive match; AttributeError on a dict; stopping before appending the sentinel turn). Predicted coincidence is measured at `tests`, and per rule 1 its repair is `author --extend`, never another split. Not `reformat_ticket`: the ticket already has the requested shape — goal line at L3, a `###` section per change at L5/20/29/42/49/54/58, specifics as bullets. The 3405-char "paragraph" is the contiguous bullet run at L31-40 with no blank lines between bullets, so the heuristic is counting a bullet block as a paragraph. Re-laying it out gains the grader nothing and risks the verbatim backticked signatures the step says must survive.

Not broken/unreachable, and naive is the healthy shape (open_feature only), so neither author_extend nor resplit applies. But the audit clears zero facts: 3 cut, 3 narrow, 2 retest. All three r2 cuts are graded behind require_feature(is_completed(f"all set {SENTINEL}") is True) — r2.rule's assertion verbatim — so their "hidden" verdicts are r2.rule re-counted; r2.failure_behavior is passed by the untouched checkout, which the ticket says returns False unconditionally. r1's four facts fire no_independent_content on each other (test_rule re-asserts observability's key/values; observability's desync block is failure_behavior arm (c) verbatim). Two correlated overshoots trace to one unstated sentence — is status stamped once or re-derived after each append — one defect per rule 5. I grepped: the r2 sentinel appears only in hidden.md, tests/test_r2.py and the oracle/spec patches, not in ticket-visible source, so the auditor's leak worry is clear; that does not rescue the cuts. Repairs are fact-text rewrites, test de-duplication and a Conversation observer hook — author-side edits no later stage produces. Proceeding grades three facts the audit says not to score (rule 7).
